title: Exit Settlement Paid by a Practice whose DHMO Primary Care Agreement Is Ending (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a practice may ask to pay an exit settlement on its Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement while that agreement is in termination pending status. The practice pays the settlement directly to Cascade, at its own request.

This rule covers only that settlement. The exit settlement is the part of the agreement's open receivable that the capitation payments still due before the termination date are not expected to recover. It is recorded as a refund received against the overpayment under recovery.

## When the settlement is fixed

An exit settlement is fixed only after the latest capitation payment carries the continuing capitation withholding owed on the overpayment under recovery.

An exit settlement is not fixed until the records carry a prompt-pay interest payment for the agreement's latest repayment of an over-recovery.

## Effect

When the practice pays, Cascade records the payment as a refund received on the practice's overpayment ledger, against the overpayment named. The open amount of that overpayment falls by the amount paid, and the practice receives a payment confirmation.

## Invocation: `pay_exit_settlement_0b962b39`

**Capability.** The practice pays Cascade its exit settlement on a DHMO primary care dentist agreement that is ending. It does so by authorising an electronic payment from its own account for the amount it has been told.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over. The customer themselves, the practice, then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `provider_agreement_id` | Reference number of the network participation agreement being settled, as read out to the practice by the representative from the agreement lookup | Id |
| `original_payment_event_id` | Reference number of the overpayment notice entry the payment is recorded against, as read out to the practice from the provider payment and overpayment lookup | Id |
| `settlement_amount` | The amount the practice pays, as stated to the practice by the representative | USD, positive, 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary confirming the payment:

- `status`: the text "received" when the payment was recorded;
- `confirmation_id`: reference number of the refund-received entry;
- `provider_agreement_id`: echoed;
- `overpayment_case_number`: case number of the overpayment the payment was recorded against;
- `amount`: USD with 2 decimal places;
- `event_date`: date YYYY-MM-DD of receipt.
